sources.excerpt: Leopard Skin Guitars - Made on a Glowforge - Glowforge Owners Forum = 40rem)" rel="stylesheet" data-target="discourse-ai_desktop" /> = 40rem)" rel="stylesheet" data-target="discourse-reactions_desktop" /> = 40rem)" rel="stylesheet" data-target="poll_desktop" /> Glowforge Owners Forum Leopard Skin Guitars Made on a Glowforge shop August 21, 2025, 1:50am 1 So, we made three “leopard skin” guitars (two telecasters and one les paul jr) for Tracii Guns of LA Guns. they’ll be taken on their next tour starting next week, played live on stage, and then sold as “stage played” guitars (along with a personal meet and greet with Tracii). “leopard skin” because that’s the album name for LA Guns’ new album. they all have the same overall pattern on them, but each has a slightly different section (with some overlap) and with some rotation/flip to make them all similar, but slightly different. Tracii received them today, seems to like the Tele, here’s his instagram video playing it.
